description: When a vein's goal is disputed, the vein is rendered in full under each goal. Each copy shows its own select and count. Nothing on the row says it is the same vein also listed under another goal; the only hint is a collapsed amber "Conflicting edits: goal".
expected: Each copy carries a note such as "Also under Lower payment fees: choose one below", or the copies render as one disputed row.
actual: Two identical rows that look like a duplicate.
suggested_fix: Render a compact "Disputed: also in <goal>" line on each copy and open its disclosure by default.
